# AI Cost Engineering and Model Routing

> Make the cost of language model applications measurable, attributable and smaller, without losing quality. SDAIA Academy course AE-312, version 2027.2.0, in English.

Each slide is a heading such as "#### [day1#slide-id] Title": cite slides by that id, and each citation is a link (slides/day1.html#slide-id). These files are what a trainee sees: no speaker notes and no answer keys.

## Course

- [Course page](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-312/index.md): overview, outcomes, schedule and labs; the page itself is https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-312/index.html
- [The whole course](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-312/llms-full.txt): every unit, session and slide in one file, about 18,955 tokens
- [Practice questions](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-312/practice.html): questions to check yourself, with feedback after each answer

## Slides

- [Day 1: Where the money goes](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-312/slides/day1.md): A cost model that matches the invoice, the sessions that cost the most, who spent what, and budgets that hold; sessions: The token cost model, Agents, retries and long contexts, Attribution and showback, Budgets and limits; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-312/slides/day1.html; about 5,515 tokens
- [Day 2: Route and cache](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-312/slides/day2.md): The cheapest configuration that keeps the quality floor, a router with a fallback, and two caches measured; sessions: Own tasks, several settings, Routing and cascades, Prompt layout for prefix caching, Semantic caches and their risks; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-312/slides/day2.html; about 5,802 tokens
- [Day 3: Host or buy, and report](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-312/slides/day3.md): Self-hosting against API prices after the data rules, a batch tier, cost per successful outcome and the review; sessions: Self-hosting economics, Batch versus interactive, Cost per successful outcome, The cost review; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-312/slides/day3.html; about 6,235 tokens
- [Capstone: Capstone: the cost review, defended](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-312/slides/capstone.md): An unseen scenario, a repository with measured results, a two-page review and a ten-minute live defence; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-312/slides/capstone.html; about 796 tokens

## Labs

- [Lab 1.1: A cost model that matches the invoice](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-312/labs/D1_1_cost_model.ipynb): Day 1, Session 1, 25 min
- [Lab 1.2: The ten most expensive sessions](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-312/labs/D1_2_expensive_sessions.ipynb): Day 1, Session 2, 25 min
- [Lab 1.3: A showback table from gateway keys](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-312/labs/D1_3_showback.ipynb): Day 1, Session 3, 25 min
- [Lab 1.4: Soft and hard budgets, and a spike](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-312/labs/D1_4_budgets.ipynb): Day 1, Session 4, 25 min
- [Lab 2.1: Three tiers, two reasoning settings, your own tasks](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-312/labs/D2_1_own_tasks.ipynb): Day 2, Session 1, 25 min
- [Lab 2.2: A two-tier router with a quality check](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-312/labs/D2_2_router.ipynb): Day 2, Session 2, 25 min
- [Lab 2.3: Prompt layout for prefix reuse](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-312/labs/D2_3_prefix_cache.ipynb): Day 2, Session 3, 25 min
- [Lab 2.4: A semantic cache and its wrong answers](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-312/labs/D2_4_semantic_cache.ipynb): Day 2, Session 4, 25 min
- [Lab 3.1: Break-even utilisation for self-hosting](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-312/labs/D3_1_break_even.ipynb): Day 3, Session 1, 25 min
- [Lab 3.2: The call-summary job on a batch tier](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-312/labs/D3_2_batch_tier.ipynb): Day 3, Session 2, 25 min
- [Lab 3.3: Cost per resolved dispute](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-312/labs/D3_3_cost_per_outcome.ipynb): Day 3, Session 3, 25 min
- [Lab 3.4: The two-page cost review](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-312/labs/D3_4_cost_review.ipynb): Day 3, Session 4, 25 min
